aria-label.zh-CN: 表单的可访问名称，写在 form 元素上。
aria-label.en-US: Accessible name of the form, set on the form element.

allowEmpty.zh-CN: 值变为空时是否在 values 中保留该字段的 key。Form 与字段任一设置为 `true` 即生效。
allowEmpty.en-US: Whether a field whose value becomes empty keeps its key in values. Setting it to `true` on either the Form or the field takes effect.

autoScrollToError.zh-CN: 提交或调用 `formApi.validate()` 校验失败时，是否自动滚动到出错的字段；传对象时作为 scroll-into-view-if-needed 的选项。
autoScrollToError.en-US: Whether to scroll to the first invalid field when submit or `formApi.validate()` fails. An object is passed to scroll-into-view-if-needed as its options.

children.zh-CN: 表单内容。传入函数时，参数为 `{ formState, values, formApi }`，用于声明表单控件。
children.en-US: The content of the form. A function receives `{ formState, values, formApi }` and declares the fields.

className.en-US: Class name of the form element.

component.zh-CN: 用于声明表单控件的组件，以 `formState`、`values`、`formApi` 作为 props 渲染；不可与 `render`、`children` 同时使用。
component.en-US: A component that declares the fields, rendered with `formState`, `values` and `formApi` as its props. Do not use it together with `render` or `children`.

disabled.zh-CN: 统一应用在每个字段上的 disabled，字段自身的 disabled 优先。
disabled.en-US: The disabled state applied to every field. A field's own disabled takes precedence.

extraTextPosition.zh-CN: 统一应用在每个字段上的 extraText 位置，`middle` 在 Label 与控件之间，`bottom` 在控件之后。未设置时为 `bottom`，字段上的同名属性优先。
extraTextPosition.en-US: Position of the extraText of every field: `middle` puts it between the label and the control, `bottom` after the control. Defaults to `bottom`. The same property on a field takes precedence.

form.zh-CN: `Form.useForm()` 返回的 formApi，用于在 Form 外部控制表单。
form.en-US: The formApi returned by `Form.useForm()`, used to control the form from outside.

getFormApi.zh-CN: Form 挂载后调用，参数为 formApi。
getFormApi.en-US: Called once the Form has mounted, with the formApi.

id.zh-CN: form 元素的 id，同时写入 `x-form-id`；不传时自动生成。
id.en-US: The id of the form element, also written to `x-form-id`. Generated when omitted.

initValues.zh-CN: 表单的初始值，仅在 Form 创建时复制一次。
initValues.en-US: Initial values of the form, copied once when the Form is created.

labelAlign.zh-CN: 统一应用在每个字段上的 label 文本对齐方式，可选 `left` 或 `right`，未设置时为 `left`。字段上的同名属性优先。
labelAlign.en-US: Text alignment of the label of every field: `left` or `right`. Defaults to `left`. The same property on a field takes precedence.

labelCol.zh-CN: 统一应用在每个字段上的 label 栅格布局，同 Col 的 span、offset 等属性，需与 wrapperCol 一起设置。
labelCol.en-US: Grid layout of the label of every field, with the properties of Col such as span and offset. Set it together with wrapperCol.

labelPosition.zh-CN: 统一应用在每个字段上的 label 位置，可选 `top`、`left` 或 `inset`，`inset` 仅部分字段支持，其余字段按 `top` 布局。字段上的同名属性优先。
labelPosition.en-US: Label position of every field: `top`, `left` or `inset`. `inset` is supported by some fields only; the others are laid out as `top`. The same property on a field takes precedence.

labelWidth.zh-CN: 统一应用在每个字段上的 label 宽度，数字单位为 px。
labelWidth.en-US: Label width of every field. A number is in px.

layout.zh-CN: 字段的排列方向，可选 `vertical` 或 `horizontal`。
layout.en-US: Direction in which the fields are arranged: `vertical` or `horizontal`.

onChange.zh-CN: 表单状态更新时调用，包括字段挂载、卸载、值变更、blur、校验状态与错误信息变更，参数为 formState。
onChange.en-US: Called when the form state changes: a field mounts, unmounts, changes its value, blurs, or changes its validation state or error. Receives formState.

onErrorChange.zh-CN: 校验状态更新时调用，参数为全部错误和本次变化的字段错误。`validate`、`submit`、`reset` 等批量操作只调用一次，静默校验不调用。
onErrorChange.en-US: Called when validation state changes, with all errors and the errors that changed. Batch operations such as `validate`, `submit` and `reset` call it once; silent validation does not.

onReset.zh-CN: 点击重置按钮或调用 `formApi.reset()` 时调用。
onReset.en-US: Called when a reset button is clicked or `formApi.reset()` is called.

onSubmit.zh-CN: 点击提交按钮或调用 `formApi.submitForm()` 且校验通过后调用，参数为 values 与提交事件。
onSubmit.en-US: Called when a submit button is clicked or `formApi.submitForm()` is called and validation passes, with values and the submit event.

onSubmitFail.zh-CN: 点击提交按钮或调用 `formApi.submitForm()` 且校验失败后调用，参数为 errors、values 与提交事件。
onSubmitFail.en-US: Called when a submit button is clicked or `formApi.submitForm()` is called and validation fails, with errors, values and the submit event.

onValueChange.zh-CN: 字段的值变化时调用，参数为全部 values 与本次变化的字段值。
onValueChange.en-US: Called when a field value changes, with all values and the values that changed.

ref.zh-CN: 指向句柄 `{ formApi }` 的引用，可通过句柄上的 formApi 控制表单。
ref.en-US: Reference to the handle `{ formApi }`, whose formApi controls the form.

render.zh-CN: 用于声明表单控件的函数，参数为 `{ formState, values, formApi }`；不可与 `component`、`children` 同时使用。
render.en-US: A function that declares the fields, called with `{ formState, values, formApi }`. Do not use it together with `component` or `children`.

showValidateIcon.zh-CN: 校验信息前是否显示对应状态的图标。
showValidateIcon.en-US: Whether the validation message is preceded by an icon of its status.

stopPropagation.zh-CN: 是否阻止 submit、reset 事件冒泡，可传 `{ submit, reset }` 分别设置，用于嵌套 Form 时避免触发外层 Form 的事件。未设置时不阻止冒泡。
stopPropagation.en-US: Whether to stop the submit and reset events from bubbling, as `{ submit, reset }`, so that a nested Form does not trigger the events of the outer one. Events bubble when it is not set.

stopValidateWithError.zh-CN: 使用 rules 校验时，遇到第一条不通过的规则后是否不再校验后续规则。字段上的同名属性优先。
stopValidateWithError.en-US: Whether to skip the remaining rules after the first rule fails. The same property on a field takes precedence.

style.en-US: Inline style of the form element.

trigger.zh-CN: 统一应用在每个字段上的校验时机，可选 `change`、`blur`、`mount`、`custom` 或其数组。字段上的同名属性优先。
trigger.en-US: When every field validates: `change`, `blur`, `mount`, `custom`, or an array of them. The same property on a field takes precedence.

validator.zh-CN: Form 级别的校验函数，submit 与 `formApi.validate()` 时调用，可返回 Promise。设置后字段自身的 validator 与 rules 不再生效。返回空字符串或空对象表示通过，失败时返回与 values 结构一致的错误对象。
validator.en-US: Form-level validation, called on submit and `formApi.validate()`, and allowed to return a Promise. When set, the validator and rules of the fields no longer apply. An empty string or object means valid; on failure return an error object shaped like the values.

wrapperCol.zh-CN: 统一应用在每个字段上的控件栅格布局，同 Col 的 span、offset 等属性，需与 labelCol 一起设置。
wrapperCol.en-US: Grid layout of the control of every field, with the properties of Col such as span and offset. Set it together with labelCol.

formApi.zh-CN: 表单的 formApi，用于读取与修改表单状态、校验与提交。
formApi.en-US: The formApi of the form, used to read and change its state, validate and submit.

children.zh-CN: 每一行的渲染函数，必填，参数为 `{ arrayFields, add, addWithInitValue }`，返回 ReactNode。
children.en-US: Required. A function that renders the rows. It receives `{ arrayFields, add, addWithInitValue }` and returns a ReactNode.

field.zh-CN: 数组在 formState.values 中的路径，必填。例如各行字段为 `a[0].name`、`a[1].name` 时应传 `a`。
field.en-US: Required. Path of the array in formState.values. For rows with fields `a[0].name` and `a[1].name`, pass `a`.

initValue.zh-CN: 数组的初始值，必须是数组；与 Form 的 `initValues` 同时配置时优先。
initValue.en-US: Initial value of the array, which must be an array. It takes precedence over the initValues of the Form.

className.en-US: Class name of the section element.

style.en-US: Inline style of the section element.

text.zh-CN: 分组标题，为空时不渲染标题。
text.en-US: The title of the section. No title is rendered when it is empty.

align.zh-CN: Label 文本的对齐方式，可选 `left` 或 `right`。
align.en-US: Text alignment of the label: `left` or `right`.

children.zh-CN: Label 的内容，`text` 未设置时使用。
children.en-US: Content of the label, used when `text` is not set.

className.en-US: Class name of the label element.

extra.zh-CN: 跟随在 label 文本后的内容。

id.en-US: The id of the label element.

name.zh-CN: 所标注控件的 id，写入 label 的 `for` 属性；不传时使用原生的 `htmlFor`。
name.en-US: The id of the labeled control, written to the `for` attribute. The native `htmlFor` is used when it is not set.

optional.zh-CN: 是否在文本后追加语言包中的可选标识。为 `true` 时不再显示 required 的 `*`。
optional.en-US: Whether to append the optional text of the locale. When `true`, the `*` of required is hidden.

required.zh-CN: 是否显示必填的 `*` 号，`optional` 为 `true` 时不显示。
required.en-US: Whether to display the required `*` symbol. It is hidden when `optional` is `true`.

style.en-US: Inline style of the label element.

text.zh-CN: Label 文本；不传时使用 children。
text.en-US: Text of the label. children is used when it is not set.

width.zh-CN: Label 宽度，数字单位为 px。
width.en-US: Width of the label. A number is in px.

disabled.zh-CN: 组内字段统一的 disabled，不传时沿用 Form 的 disabled。
disabled.en-US: The disabled state applied to the fields in the group. Falls back to the Form's disabled when not set.

extraText.zh-CN: 额外的提示信息，位置由 `extraTextPosition` 决定。
extraText.en-US: Extra text of the group, positioned by `extraTextPosition`.

extraTextPosition.zh-CN: extraText 的位置，`middle` 在 Label 与 Group 之间，`bottom` 在 Group 之后。未设置时为 `bottom`。
extraTextPosition.en-US: Position of the extra text: `middle` puts it between the label and the group, `bottom` after the group. Defaults to `bottom`.

label.zh-CN: 整个 Group 的 Label：对象作为 Label 配置，其中 `id` 用作 Label 的 id，其他内容作为 Label 文本。
label.en-US: Label of the whole group: an object is the label configuration, whose `id` becomes the id of the label, and any other content is the label text.

labelPosition.zh-CN: Label 的位置，默认取自 Form，可选 `top` 或 `left`。
labelPosition.en-US: Label position. Defaults to the Form's, and can be `top` or `left`.

onBlur.zh-CN: 焦点离开组内任一控件时调用，在组内控件之间移动焦点时也会调用。
onBlur.en-US: Called as focus leaves any control in the group, also for a move to another control in it.

onFocus.zh-CN: 组内任一控件获得焦点时调用，从组内另一控件移入时也会调用。
onFocus.en-US: Called as any control in the group takes focus, also for a move from another control in it.

ref.zh-CN: 组内 InputGroup 的根元素（`role="group"`）的引用。
ref.en-US: Reference to the root element of the InputGroup inside (`role="group"`).

size.zh-CN: 组内控件的尺寸，可选 `small`、`default` 或 `large`；未自行设置 `size` 的控件取这个值。
size.en-US: Size of the controls in the group: `small`, `default` or `large`; controls that set no `size` of their own take it.

error.zh-CN: 错误信息，渲染在内容之后：对象作为 ErrorMessage 的属性，其他内容作为错误内容；不传则不显示。
error.en-US: The error, rendered after the content: an object is the props of ErrorMessage and any other content is the error. Nothing shows when omitted.

label.zh-CN: Label 配置：对象作为 Form.Label 的属性，可配置 `text`、`extra`、`align`、`width`、`required`、`optional` 等；其他内容作为 Label 文本。
label.en-US: Label configuration: an object is the props of Form.Label, with `text`, `extra`, `align`, `width`, `required`, `optional` and so on; any other content is the label text.

labelPosition.zh-CN: slot 的 Label 位置，默认取自 Form，可选 `top` 或 `left`。
labelPosition.en-US: Label position of the slot. Defaults to the Form's, and can be `top` or `left`.

noLabel.zh-CN: 是否不渲染 Label；Form 同时设置了 labelCol 与 wrapperCol 时，Label 列仍保留。
noLabel.en-US: Whether to render no label. When the Form sets both labelCol and wrapperCol, the label column is still kept.

ref.zh-CN: 根 div 元素的引用。
ref.en-US: Reference to the root div element.

className.en-US: Class name of the error message element.

error.zh-CN: 错误信息。字符串与 ReactNode 直接显示，数组会用 `, ` 合并其中的错误；`true` 只显示错误态容器，没有文本；`false` 与空值不渲染。
error.en-US: The error. A string or ReactNode is shown as is and an array is joined with `, `. `true` shows the error container without text; `false` and empty values render nothing.

errorMessageId.zh-CN: 错误文本元素的 id，供 `aria-errormessage` 引用。
errorMessageId.en-US: The id of the error text element, referenced by `aria-errormessage`.

helpText.zh-CN: 提示信息，与错误信息共用同一区块，两者都有时显示错误信息。
helpText.en-US: The help text. It shares the block with the error, and the error is shown when both are set.

helpTextId.zh-CN: 提示文本元素的 id，供 `aria-describedby` 引用。
helpTextId.en-US: The id of the help text element, referenced by `aria-describedby`.

isInInputGroup.zh-CN: 是否位于 InputGroup 中；为 `true` 且 `showValidateIcon` 为 `true` 时，不论 `validateStatus` 都显示错误图标。
isInInputGroup.en-US: Whether it is inside an InputGroup. When it and `showValidateIcon` are `true`, the error icon shows whatever `validateStatus` is.

ref.en-US: Reference to the error message element.

showValidateIcon.zh-CN: 是否显示 `validateStatus` 对应的图标。
showValidateIcon.en-US: Whether to show the icon of `validateStatus`.

style.zh-CN: 错误信息元素的内联样式。
style.en-US: Inline style of the error message element.

validateStatus.zh-CN: 信息所属的校验状态，可选 `default`、`error`、`warning`、`success`。
validateStatus.en-US: Validation status of the message: `default`, `error`, `warning` or `success`.
